`sed -n '/^## Executive Summary/,/^## /p' docs/q3_report.md`

To save it directly:

`mkdir -p output && sed -n '/^## Executive Summary/,/^## /p' docs/q3_report.md > output/q3_executive_summary.md`

If the next heading is included at the end, remove its last line:

`sed -i '$d' output/q3_executive_summary.md`

Alternatively, open `docs/q3_report.md` in a text editor, find the “Executive Summary” heading, and copy everything up to—but not including—the next same-level heading into `./output/q3_executive_summary.md`.
